appId.description: Bundle id / package name (a suite of only http steps may leave it out)

accessibility.description: Accessibility audit of the screens each test reads (docs/DSL.md#accessibility-audit)

audit.description: Audit each distinct screen once per test and report findings as warnings (default off)

density.description: Android pixels per dp for the 48 dp target size (default: the screen's short side is 411 dp)

fail.description: Fail a test on an error-severity finding

actionability.description: strict (default): an action fails when its target never holds still, stays disabled or is covered; lenient: act anyway with a warning

ai.description: The model service for natural-language steps and checks; ATALANTA_NL_* environment variables win over it

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the key (never the key itself)

apiVersion.description: Azure OpenAI api-version (deployments URL); unset uses /openai/v1

images.description: Send screenshots to the checker (default: the provider's)

model.description: Model for single steps and checks; may be provider:model

provider.description: A provider preset: the native APIs (anthropic, openai, azure-openai, gemini, bedrock, vertex), OpenAI-compatible services (openrouter, groq, mistral, deepseek, xai, together, fireworks, dashscope, perplexity), local servers (ollama, lmstudio, vllm) or openai-compatible with baseUrl; docs/AI-PROVIDERS.md

region.description: Bedrock AWS region or Vertex location

app.description: App build Atalanta installs before the first test (skipped when the device has this exact build): one path, or one per platform

logs.description: Capture device logs per test (logcat, simulator log stream, browser console), kept for failed tests by default; secrets are masked

screenshots.description: screenshot: steps write at once, only for a failing test, or not at all

stepScreenshots.description: Screen after every step, written only for a failing test

video.description: Record each test's screen (Android: H.264 ring buffer; iOS simulator: simctl recordVideo; web: screencast frames), kept for failed tests by default, as traces/<test>/video.mp4

videoSeconds.description: Android: seconds of video kept in memory per test (default 30)

batch.description: Share one launch across consecutive tests

allow.description: Programs exec steps may run, exactly as a step names them (adb, ./scripts/seed.sh); exec is off without them

devicePixelRatio.description: Physical px per logical px: native headless density, Flutter test surface ratio

fontScale.description: Text size multiplier for native headless renders (default 1)

mode.description: auto: heal and pass; report: fail with the proposed patch (default in CI); off

baseUrl.description: Prefix of an http step's url without a scheme

insecure.description: Accept any TLS certificate (a dev server's self-signed one)

timeoutMs.description: How long a request may take (default 30000); a step's timeoutMs overrides it

allowCrossOrigin.description: A natural-language goto may leave the current page's origin

dataPolicy.description: describe: the model sees only a description of each data value

performance.description: Opt-in memory profiling and the memory check (Android only: the other drivers report no memory)

enabled.description: Sample the app's memory and CPU during the run (default false)

intervalMs.description: Sampling interval during long actions, in ms (default 500)

pssGrowthThresholdPct.description: Fail a test whose peak total PSS is more than this percent above its saved baseline (default 15). Only clean passes update the baseline. Was heapGrowthThresholdPct, which still works with a warning

reactNative.description: Ignored: React Native has no headless renderer (run on a device or simulator)

flakyResult.description: fail: a test that passed only on retry exits 1 (as --fail-on-flaky)

freezeStatusBar.description: Freeze the status bar (Android demo mode, iOS simulator simctl status_bar) before assertScreenshot and compare it instead of masking it

settings.description: Driver and runtime settings (`atalanta settings` lists them); flat `android.scroll:` or nested keys

maxTimerMs.description: Native probe: one-shot timers due further out than this don't keep the app busy (default 1500; iOS probe)

verify.description: AI checks: off (default; deterministic assertions only), final (the test's description holds at the end), checkpoints (also after assert: and checkpoint: steps; failures reported at the end), strict (the first failed check fails the test)

device.description: A mobile-web profile from Playwright's device list (any name, or "<name> landscape"): viewport, pixel ratio, user agent, mobile layout and touch (Chromium, not Safari)

url.description: Glob over the whole URL (with * or ?), else a substring of it

parallelMode.description: What each --parallel browser is: contexts (default: browser contexts in one Chrome, each with its own cookies, storage and mocks) or processes (a Chrome process each)

settle.description: Web-only settle timings; they win over sync.* on the web (defaults: 30 ms reaction, sync.quietMs, 1 s cap)

description.description: What the test shows; verify: final checks it on the last screen (the name stands in without it)

sideEffects.description: Never skip this test from the result cache

verify.description: This test's AI verification level, over config.verify
